no_harm_guard.depth_command_d: git show REV:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | python3 -c 'import re,sys; n=len(re.findall(r"^#   (?:js|bash)-\S+\s+\S+\s+\d+/\d+",sys.stdin.read(),re.M)); print("recorded_cases=%d depth_score=%d"%(n,min(10,n)))'
no_harm_guard.note: This regex is the SCORECARD.md command D pattern. The round-38 regex ^\s*leg is left untouched and is the vacuous control.

settlement.predicate: SETTLED iff every seat has a terminal timestamp and parent_exit_unix >= max(terminal_unix). A parent exit before the last terminal is UNSETTLED.
